purpose: Independent heldout authorship for Pulpo PR782 R29

unavailable_desired_coverage.coverage: Cross-process queued writer overlap or suspension
unavailable_desired_coverage.reason: Sequential retained actors and the real same-process queue cannot model a separately suspended process or syscall gate.

unavailable_desired_coverage.coverage: Failed disk write and subsequent retry
unavailable_desired_coverage.reason: No filesystem fault injection is exposed by the action schema.
The interface exposes PersonalDictionary operations only.

unavailable_desired_coverage.coverage: Actual English, Spanish, and mixed language stacks
unavailable_desired_coverage.reason: There is no language-mode selector; varied spellings are wording diversity only.

unavailable_desired_coverage.coverage: Clock-controlled delays or timestamp collision scheduling
unavailable_desired_coverage.reason: No clocks or sleep actions exist.
No caret or edit actions exist.
No ranking query or ranking input exists.
There is no public notification action in the adapter.

execution: Static validator only; no production execution or runtime outcome claims.

authorship_assurance.read_scope: Only the three hash-verified immutable artifacts and self-authored temporary output.
authorship_assurance.excluded_inputs: No production source, development tests or inputs, prior benches, result inputs, or agent conversation history were consulted.
authorship_assurance.wording_and_action_order: Original independent descriptions, spellings, and action sequences.
authorship_assurance.coverage: Retained writer resets; dirty pre-reset edits; repeated resets; relearning; ordinary external save and reload; external forgetting; pin counts; spelling and pair normalization; own queue handling; same-process pre-clear queue; transient words; no-URL isolation.
authorship_assurance.queue_scope: Same-process sequential ordering only; no cross-process suspension claim.
authorship_assurance.language_scope: English, Spanish, and mixed spellings provide wording diversity only.
authorship_assurance.freeze_and_once_only_reveal: Sealed for parent-controlled production freeze and independent review before once-only reveal; no reveal or post-reveal tuning performed here.
